_comment: Defaults. Do NOT edit here for local tweaks: put overrides in %LOCALAPPDATA%\desktop-mcp\config.json (same keys, merged over these). No secrets in this file: the API key comes from the DESKTOP_MCP_API_KEY environment variable.
_allow_comment: Processes where click/type/set_value/drag/move are allowed. "*" = every process not in the deny lists (the server is meant for any app). List exe names instead of "*" to restrict; anything not listed is then read-only (screenshot, ui_tree, read_value).
_deny_comment: Never controlled, even for reading, even if also in the allow list. Complete it with your own (e.g. a browser with a banking session).

input._freeze_comment: Off by default (user preference 2026-09-23): the user keeps full control of the mouse. true = freeze the physical mouse during SendInput strokes/clicks so it cannot mix with Claude's
